fields.default: Four sessions between your phone demo and a finished record

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Bring the songs to Low Road Studios. We bring the room, the microphones and an engineer who has heard every mistake before.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: What gets done in this session.

default.title: Pre-production
default.text: One evening with your demos. We settle tempos, keys and what each song really needs.

default.title: Tracking
default.text: Drums and bass go down first in the live room, then guitars, keys and vocals.

default.title: Mixing
default.text: We balance every song at the desk and send it over. You get three rounds of notes.

default.title: Mastering
default.text: A final polish for streaming and vinyl, delivered as files you own outright.
